proposed_portrait_rule.title: Beauticate standard for in-body portrait images
proposed_portrait_rule.problem: 8,881 portrait images vs 3,186 landscape. Most portraits are ~300px WP 'medium' thumbnails placed as plain markdown ![](). @tailwindcss/typography applies no width/centering, so a 300px portrait renders at 300px inline, LEFT-flush in the 720px column ('tiny, left-aligned'); a >720px portrait is capped to 720px and dominates. Hence inconsistent sizing. Verified from CSS/code (tailwind.config typography has no img override; ArticlePage mdxComponents has no img: key), not from a live screenshot.

rule.landscape (w>h): Full width of the 720px body measure (current plain-markdown behaviour is fine). Optional .article-wide breakout to 1200px for hero-grade shots only.
rule.portrait (h>w): Route through ONE standard container: centred (mx-auto), fixed max-width 460px (never upscaled beyond the file's own width), 3:4-ish, white space above/below, caption beneath. NO text wrapping, NO left-flush, NO alternating float. Consistent every time.

proposed_portrait_rule.recommended_implementation: Add an `img` override to mdxComponents in ArticlePage.tsx that reads intrinsic dimensions and, for portrait/square, wraps in the centred fixed-width figure; landscape stays full-measure. This fixes the ~1,100 systemic articles in one change with no per-file editing. Alternatively bulk-convert lone portrait ![]() to <InlineImage align="center" width=460 …>.
proposed_portrait_rule.note_on_existing_components: Sig's hand-fixes used FOUR different portrait treatments (Portrait float ~360px alternating; InlineImage px-width left; StickyScroll parallax; PortraitQuote). Recommend standardising the DEFAULT on centred-fixed-width; keep StickyScroll/PortraitQuote as deliberate one-per-story editorial devices, and retire the left-default on InlineImage/Portrait float. Needs Sig's sign-off — three spec docs disagree (Component Library='centred, no wrap'; article-layout-tiers='portrait→sticky parallax split'; Portrait.tsx=float+wrap).
